name: c3
description: Runs the `c3` binary as a read-only reviewer bridge from Claude Code and records each consultation as files (brief, verbatim reply, JSON ledger, findings tracked by id), with per-reviewer thread lineages, a fail-closed provider preflight, a reviewer roster and (planned) a review panel and further engines (Gemini through agy, Meta Muse through muse); needs the `c3` binary on PATH or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT-relative, git, and the Codex CLI signed in to ChatGPT or given a [model_providers] table whose env key the user sets.
